summary.label_note: Motif-sequence co-occurrence hypotheses; not ChromBPNet, not occupancy, not physical interaction.

params.background: lift/q: GC quintile x accessibility tertile x motif-density tertile x repeat; lift_basic/q_basic: same without motif density

cbp.model: ENCODE ChromBPNet HepG2 ATAC (HF kundajelab/encode-chrombpnet-ATAC-HepG2-ENCSR291GJU-ENCSR380YGX), fold_0 bias-corrected
cbp.method: pretrained ChromBPNet (bias-corrected) - trained on bulk ATAC of the matching cell line, not on these fragments. Contributions: integrated gradients (6 steps, 1 dinucleotide-shuffled reference, counts head) on CPU.
